newsitem.title: THAILAND: Trade in Krungthai Thanakit to resume.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Krungthai Thanakit to resume.

text.p: The Thai bourse said on Monday that it had allowed trading to resume with immediate effect in Krungthai Thanakit Plc, after it was halted earlier on Monday afternoon.
The exchange had halted trading in the company because it said it was awaiting some undisclosed material information from the finance and securities firm.

Soon after the halt in trading was announced the company released its first quarter 1997 results. Its net profit in the quarter slid to 70.80 million baht from 311.16 million in the corresponding quarter in 1996, it said.
